text:
jamie: Quick Q — where are the saved log queries for EU gen route errors? tuning alerts for 5xx by model/org. Trying to find a saved view I used last month.

theo: There's a saved view list in Observability -> Logsearch -> Saved Views. For EU gen 5xx we have a saved search but name changed. Try this direct link: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/logs/saved?view=eu-gen-5xx-by-model (might need SSO).

jamie: link 403 for me :thinking_face:

ops-bot: Reminder: access requires azure-ad group 'eng-sre'. If you need access, ping @people-ops.

theo: Ah — maybe it's org-scoped. Try running this in logsearch quick query:

``` 
service:inference AND route:gen AND region:eu-west1 AND status:[500 TO 599]
| group_by model, org_id
| sort desc count
```

Add `org_id:acme` if you want acme-only.

priya: For model-level breakdown add `model:"redwood/gpt-4o-mini"` or use wildcard `model:/gpt-4o/`. Saved views we use are named:
- eu-gen-5xx-overall
- eu-gen-5xx-by-model
- eu-gen-5xx-acme-filter

If none exist I can re-create.

jamie: Awesome — can you create eu-gen-5xx-by-model and share link?

marta: I'll create it and add to dashboards. Quick note for alert tuning: increase eval window to 5m and alert on sustained pct > 1% 500s over 5m to avoid noisy blips. Will attach PR to infra-alerts.

theo: Example saved query payload (CLI):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/logs/saved_views \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
 -d '{
  "name":"eu-gen-5xx-by-model",
  "query":"service:inference AND route:gen AND region:eu-west1 AND status:[500 TO 599] | group_by model",
  "filters": ["region:eu-west1"],
  "owner":"eng-sre"
 }'

(Replace quotes/escaping as needed)

jamie: Thanks. Also pinging @marta for a quick code review on the dashboard link change — small YAML in infra/dashboards -> add savedViewId. Should be safe.

marta: On it. I'll push change and link once saved view exists. ETA 30m.

priya: FYI, when you create the view include KV cache errors filter `error_type:kvcache` — we've seen a couple spikes.

marta: noted.

jamie: Great, closing loop — if you mess with alert thresholds keep me posted. :thumbsup:
